name: Lava Field
desc: A cooled pahoehoe plain at night lit from below — a black basalt crust runs to a smoke-choked horizon, fractured into plates by a network of incandescent cracks where the molten still shows through, heat pulsing and advecting along them, glowing skylights breathing over lava tubes, fume drifting up off the field and embers rising; fresh orange pahoehoe, a deep-red night of heavy smoke, sulfurous yellow-green gas, thermal false-colour ironbow, or sumi ink with a white-hot crack network.

energy.doc: how hard the glow works — crack brightness, ambient heat wash, ember and skylight intensity

scale.doc: how large the crack and plate structure is — crack width, skylight size (rebuilds the field)

density.doc: how many cracks, skylights, embers and crust mottling

speed.doc: fume drift, crack pulse, heat advection and ember rate

heat.doc: how molten the field is — how bright and incandescent the cracks and skylights burn

fume.doc: how much smoke and gas drifts up off the field

hue.doc: palette hue shift off the default orange incandescence

x.doc: where the main heat glow biases across the foreground

y.doc: the horizon line — low y gives more field, high y more smoke sky

style.doc: aesthetic: pahoehoe = fresh black basalt, orange-yellow cracks, ember-red sky; nightfume = heavy night smoke, deep-red glow, menacing; sulfur = sulfurous acid yellow-green gas; thermal = false-colour ironbow, cracks as hot isotherms; ink = sumi basalt plates with a white-hot crack network

act.doc: multi-minute programme — the field cooling with the glow breathing, a fresh breakout burning brighter with more embers over sections, or a mostly-cooled crust with faint glow and heavy fume

seed.doc: regenerates the crack network, skylights, crust mottling and fume

alpha.doc: how far the world sits back behind the performers
